text:
Alex: Quick sync on telemetry: proposing a conservative default for request/response logging and PII redaction.
A few concrete proposals:
- Full request/response capture: 0.1% (for debugging/regressions)
- Metadata-only sampling (headers, latencies, route, model): 10%
- All captured payloads run through hybrid redaction: regex + structured PII detector
- Opt-in debug capture via feature flag per org/team
Thoughts?

Priya: +1 on conservative defaults. We need to confirm retention windows and export rules (e.g., legal holds). Also: clarify what counts as metadata-only — must exclude any free-text user content.

Marco: Agree. Also a couple of infra concerns:
- Sampling should be deterministic per request-id so retries don't spike sample counts.
- We should avoid blocking the critical path: sampling decision at ingress, redaction async if possible.
- Metrics: emit sampled_count, estimated_total_tokens_logged for billing/alerts.

Li: Implementation sketch (ingress pseudoconfig):
```yaml
sampling:
  deterministic_by: request_id
  full_capture_rate: 0.001    # 0.1%
  metadata_only_rate: 0.10   # 10%
redaction:
  mode: hybrid
  regex_patterns:
    - email: "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}"
    - cc_number: "\b(?:\d[ -]*?){13,16}\b"
  structured_detector: "pii-detector-v2"
  scrub_fields: ["user_message", "assistant_message"]
debug:
  feature_flag: "telemetry.debug_full_logs"
```
Note: structured_detector runs a small model for entity detection; we should set a cpu/gpu budget.

Priya: Regex is fine but we must not rely on it alone. detector model needs hard guarantees on false negatives — can we add configurable confidence thresholds and fallback to redact by default if detector unsure? Also customer-specific allowlists (enterprise) — require approval and explicit opt-in.

Marco: Fallback redact-by-default makes sense. For deterministic sampling: use a stable hash of (org_id + request_id) and compare to threshold. That allows per-org overrides without global churn.

Nora: From product/console UX POV:
- Customers need visibility: show sampling % and a small gallery of sampled redacted examples in the console.
- Add a toggle for "request-level debug" that opens a request to support (not on by default).
- For Dedicated/Private customers, expose per-org retention & sample rate settings in a limited UI.

Alex: What about storing a non-reversible fingerprint to correlate logs without keeping PII? e.g., hashed user_id with per-customer salt.

Priya: Yes — do HMAC with a per-customer key stored in KMS and rotateable. Document key rotation semantics (old hashes remain for a period). No raw IDs in logs.

Li: HMAC-SHA256 per-customer is fine, but it's extra CPU. We can do it in the ingress worker pool — benchmarked ~0.6ms per call on our nodes. If we see cost pushback we can move to batch hashing.

Marco: Also watch out for sampling bias: if we pick based on request_id hash, long-tail users might be under-observed. Consider a hybrid: small probabilistic boost for errors/latency spikes and for dev keys.

Priya: Retention: propose 90 days for metadata-only, 30 days for full captures by default. Enterprise customers can request longer retention under contract. Compliance-bot: note.

compliance-bot: Policy reminder: default retention 90 days (metadata), 30 days (full capture). Legal hold flow: /legal-hold create <org> esc.

Nora: Console should surface retention clearly and allow export for legal requests (with ACL checks). Also show redaction confidence score per sample so support knows reliability.

Alex: Rollout plan suggestion:
1) Feature-flag the sampling/redaction pipeline behind `telemetry.v2`.
2) Enable for 10% of orgs (random deterministic) for 2 weeks, collect metrics (rate of PII hits, processing lag, cost delta).
3) Iterate rules, then 50% -> 100%.
We should have an escape hatch to turn off structured_detector if latency/cost spikes.

Li: I can implement the config and feature-flag rollout. Need a short RFC for infra changes (ingress hook, async redaction workers).

Marco: I'll add sampling/processing metrics and alert thresholds. Also will add a dashboard tile in the ops console for sampled token volume.

Priya: I'll update the privacy/PII policy doc with exact regexes, detector versions, and retention. Also to add KMS key handling and legal hold playbook.

Alex: Great. Action items then:
- Priya: privacy doc & legal hold notes
- Li: ingress config + HMAC implementation
- Marco: metrics + dashboard
- Nora: console mockups for sampled gallery & retention UI
We'll reconvene in a week. :thumbsup:

Nora: :+1: I'll post mocks to #design once ready.

Priya: tiny nit — add a conformance test in CI that verifies scrub_fields are never present in exported logs.

Alex: Good call. Adding to the RFC. Thanks all.
